summary.text: Kristey Williams is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 77 who has served since January 2015 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She has worked in insurance sales and as a science teacher, and she was elected mayor of Augusta, Kansas, in 2007.

paragraphs.text: Kristey Williams was born in Wichita, Kansas, and graduated from Augusta High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree in biology from the University of Kansas in 1993.
Her career includes insurance sales and work as a science teacher in the Buhler and Andover school districts, and she has volunteered with Project Play Park and the Save Our State Street Campaign.
Williams was elected mayor of Augusta, Kansas, in 2007, and she assumed office in the Kansas House on January 12, 2015.

For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Commerce, Labor and Economic Development, Insurance, Elections, Legislative Budget and Legislative Post Audit committees, and she served as vice chair of the House Legislative Budget Committee and the Appropriations Committee.
Troy Nicks is the Democratic candidate in the November 2026 general election for the seat.
